say: You got a raise. So why are you still broke?
Nearly half of Americans earning over a hundred thousand dollars, say they live paycheck to paycheck.
show: Nearly half of Americans earning $100K+ say they live paycheck to paycheck.

say: Every raise quietly turns into a bigger car, a nicer apartment, more takeout.
And your brain adapts fast. Psychologists call it, the hedonic treadmill.
show: And your brain adapts fast. Psychologists call it the hedonic treadmill.

say: The new stuff feels normal in weeks, so you need more to feel the same.
Income goes up. Spending goes up. Savings stay at zero.
The fix? Save half of every raise, the day it hits your account.
You'll never miss money you never got used to.
Because if you don't, next year you'll get another raise
